subject: Insurance
title: Monte Carlo Simulations
description: A fast breakdown of Monte Carlo Simulations for builders.

hook.text: Monte Carlo simulations run thousands of random scenarios to estimate risk.

buildup.text: Instead of one prediction, Monte Carlo generates 10,000 possible outcomes.

discovery.text: Insurers use Monte Carlo to test portfolios.

twist.text: The method was developed for nuclear weapons by Stanislaw Ulam in 1946.

climax.text: Monte Carlo doesn't predict the future. It maps the landscape of possibilities, showing insurers where the dangers live.

quiz.question: What do Monte Carlo simulations do for insurers?
options: Run thousands of random scenarios to estimate risk ranges
